trello.name: Add queue depth alerting for worker fleet
trello.desc: Kofi to add alerting on queue depth across the entire worker fleet (not just payments) with consistent thresholds: warning at 1,000 jobs and page at 5,000 jobs. Done in one pass.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic with dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Marta to fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py (_process_with_retry function): implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the retries, and route failed jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back instead of re-enqueuing at the front of the main queue. Add tests that simulate processor 503s.

trello.name: Bump and split DB connection pools
trello.desc: Kofi to bump the DB connection pool from the default of 20 to 100 and split worker and API pools so they no longer share, both changes in the same config file.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Priya to refresh the payment incident runbook: replace old Kibana logging links with current ones, document the queue drain procedure Kofi improvised during the outage, and verify escalation phone numbers are current (one still routes to a departed employee). Kofi to confirm assignment with Priya after the meeting.

trello.name: Automate status page updates on checkout alert
trello.desc: Marta to wire the status page so that when the checkout error rate alert fires, the status page automatically flips to investigating with a template message, using the status provider's API. Start with the checkout alert; can extend to other alerts later.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Kofi to draft a controlled chaos test plan for the payment processor failover: staging first, then production during a low-traffic window, with a rollback plan. Plan to be reviewed by the team in two weeks before any execution. No execution until the review.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from EOL 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Kofi to upgrade Redis from 6.0 (security fixes ended in June) to 7.2. Involves a config rename and changed persistence defaults, so it must be scheduled as a proper change window via the infra calendar, not a casual deploy.

trello.name: Write and distribute incident timeline doc
trello.desc: Ines to write up the incident timeline document tonight and send it out tomorrow.
